init_score_note: LightGBM folds the starting score into the first tree, so the raw score is the plain sum of leaf values.
missing_rule: A null or NaN input goes left when d is true, otherwise right. Any other value goes left when value <= t.
interactive_note: Inputs without a control stay at their training median. Some combinations a visitor can set (a high yearly cost with a small largest encounter) are ones the model never saw in training.
calibrator_note: The calibrator takes the sigmoid of the raw score. Interpolate linearly between points and clip outside them.
score_percentiles_source: calibrated probability, test years [2024, 2025], percentiles 0 to 100
